trigger: Severe pain, chest pain, fainting, acute confusion, blood in stool, persistent vomiting, unexplained weight loss, suspected emergency
urgency: Urgent or prompt depending on severity
handoff_instruction: Stop routine coaching and clearly recommend appropriate professional assessment

trigger: User need clearly falls within a specialist domain
handoff_instruction: Transfer context, goals and relevant history so the user does not repeat themselves

trigger: Persistent bloating, bowel-pattern complexity, or multi-pillar digestive symptoms
handoff_instruction: Share hydration pattern and relevant symptom timeline

trigger: Marked persistent thirst, very low urine output, oedema, suspected fluid restriction, or concerning kidney/cardiac symptoms
handoff_instruction: Do not offer aggressive fluid advice

trigger: User needs recipes, meal sequencing or a practical shopping plan
handoff_instruction: Share dietary aims, tolerances and HERNE context
Share symptoms only as context, not as diagnosis

trigger: Supplement use in menstrual, fertility, perimenopause or menopause context
handoff_instruction: Flag pregnancy, medicines and hormone-sensitive history

trigger: Abnormal bleeding, severe pelvic pain, pregnancy concerns, fertility red flags or suspected endocrine disorder
Wearable-led performance, HRV, recovery or workload analysis
handoff_instruction: Share training goals and current programme

trigger: Chest pain, syncope, unexplained marked performance decline or suspected hormonal/prostate condition
Food change appears to worsen gut symptoms or requires symptom interpretation
handoff_instruction: Share meal plan and timing details

trigger: User asks about supplementing a nutrient rather than food sources
handoff_instruction: Share dietary pattern and known restrictions

trigger: Medication interaction, pregnancy, kidney/liver disease, high-dose plan, or suspected deficiency needing testing
Trend suggests a domain issue requiring contextual interpretation
handoff_instruction: Share trend summary, confidence and device limitations

trigger: Persistent major deviation from baseline with concerning symptoms
handoff_instruction: Explain that wearable data is not diagnostic
